speaker: kai_patel
headline: A SYSTEM THAT CANNOT LEARN WILL REPEAT THE SAME FAILURE.
deck: Feedback must travel from observation to action and back into the operating model.
quote: Automation matters less than whether the system can see what happened and change what it does next.
facts: Detection without response only creates a better alarm.
Routing must connect signals to an accountable action path.
Verification tells the system whether the intervention worked.
Learning closes the loop by changing the next response.
takeaway: A digital service becomes resilient when every incident becomes usable feedback for the next decision.
